articles.title: OpenAI & Cisco team up on AI defense system 'Shirudo': Learn more from these execs
articles.summary:
Cisco (CSCO) and OpenAI (OPAI.PVT) are partnering on Shirudo, a defense system against AI-powered cyberattacks.

Cisco president and chief product officer Jeetu Patel and OpenAI co-founder and president Greg Brockman sit down with Deirdre Bosa to discuss the details.
